name: weyland-fixture-typescript
description: Hello-world fixture for the TypeScript lane (B88). DEPENDENCY-FREE by design: node:24 runs `node --test` and strips TS types natively, so this lane needs no npm install, no lockfile and no registry round-trip. Scan tools (eslint/license-checker, typescript) are devDependencies: the TEST lane never installs them (no `test` script means it uses node --test directly), so the dependency-free test property survives; the SCAN lane installs them.
